function.name: review_sap_code
function.description: Perform a read-only code review / bug search / error analysis of an existing SAP object WITHOUT modifying it. Use this when the user asks to find a bug, find an error, explain what is wrong, review, audit, inspect, analyze, or give a conclusion without fixing. It reads the object source itself, so do NOT call read_sap_object first. To review several objects, call it once per object. Result is a <code_analysis> envelope.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to review

focus_areas.description: Aspects to focus on; default all
